verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration-services platform that collects sensitive applicant and employer data, so data region or residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options, or where data is hosted; the pages cover only visa workflows, attorney review, and fees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
